name: Hayama Rei
source:
Star Sign: Aries
Special Skill/Hobby: Watching Movies, Cooking
Favorite Food: Cold Pasta with Tomatoes and Nuts
Disliked Food: Sweets

A researcher for Hayama Pharmaceuticals.
A university friend of [url=/c54871]Shinji's[/url]. Even though his last name is different he's [url=/c40225]Daichi's[/url] true older brother.
He always seems cold and it's impossible to tell what he's thinking.
